verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Locations page explicitly documents 18 offices across North America, Europe, and Asia (e.g., Boston, Silicon Valley, London, Munich, Paris, Hong Kong, Singapore), and its VC and tech practice pages reinforce multinational, cross-border deal and fund formation capability, directly supporting the founder's expansion-without-a-second-firm need. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of actual multi-jurisdiction qualification (e.g., bar admissions per office) and concrete cross-border client case studies beyond the firm's own claims.
